name: dv
description: David Villavicencio's personal Claude Code skill suite. Every skill first runs dv-latest-check, which holds dv-dependent actions when the dv it was loaded from is not the latest stable release or that cannot be verified. dv:pickup and dv:handoff bracket a session (hydrate context at the start, serialize state at the end); dv:review-claudemd keeps CLAUDE.md honest by mining conversation history; dv:tmux-window-namer styles tmux windows with a glyph, title, and palette; dv:reddit and dv:twitter fetch and summarize Reddit threads / X posts via public APIs (no auth); dv:critique stress-tests a plan with three parallel critique subagents; dv:cite enforces a re-fetch-or-decline freshness contract on realtime-fact queries; dv:mnemosyne-ops enables, health-checks, and maintains the Mnemosyne memory provider on a Hermes profile (gated enable, drift checks for carried patches and leaked system turns); dv:orca-setup writes, tests, and ships an Orca worktree setup script (orca.yaml) that leaves state other checkouts depend on untouched; dv:manager-mode switches a session into Manager Mode, where it plans, briefs and checks while hired agents on named model tiers (or procedures run by them) do the engineering (`off` switches it back); dv:director-mode switches the home session (the main checkout) into Director Mode: it names newly unblocked tickets, recommends which worktree sessions to start and which can run in parallel, takes closeout notes, releases a finished worktree session it started as a supervised Orca worker, or asks you to close an ordinary one in Orca, once its checks pass, merges and cleans up after MergeWren passes, and keeps ticket states true, while each worktree session runs dv:manager-mode and hires (`off` switches it back); dv:ticket files a Linear ticket in the agreed format from a rough request and writes to Linear only after confirmation, except a spin-off filed by a session with dv:manager-mode on and a closeout item filed by a session with dv:director-mode on; dv:groom grooms an existing one (verification, neighbors, size, split, scouting for spin-offs, an interview on open decisions) and edits it only after approval (or, with `forks-only`, decides routine calls itself, asks only the real forks and records what it decided), without starting the work; dv:closeout closes out a finished worktree session: it verifies the ticket, the PRs and what the worktree still holds, writes a note for the parent session in the main checkout, says whether the worktree is safe to delete, and archives the session's handoff when it is; dv:new-project bootstraps a new project on the personal Mac in one run (a checkout with a bootstrap commit, a private GitHub repository whose visibility is read back before anything is pushed, the Orca registration, a scriptorium section with the harness memory linked into it, the Linear project and a MergeWren onboarding ticket), running its checks before the first write, stopping there only on a collision or a check that can't run, and on a rerun doing only what is missing or stopping and saying why.
